MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  NOVEMBER 14, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 5:37
p.m. in the City Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  City Clerk Heidi Luce

DISCUSSION ITEM: WORKSHOP ON BROADBAND NETWORKS

The City Council heard a presentation from Jory Wolf from Magellan Advisors regarding regional
broadband efforts and strategies cities can implement to address the growing need for improved
broadband technology, including developing public policy to guide the process. Mr. Wolf noted
several advantages for cities investing in broadband technology including reduced cost for
broadband service and potential revenue from fiber assets.

Council members discussed the opportunities for implementing broadband technology in the City
noting that the opportunities in Rolling Hills Estates focus around the business district and
additional fiber options for City facilities.

Additional discussed ensued regarding the possibility of including a conduit drop in the trench
that will house the new Cal-Water pipeline. Staff indicated that Cal-Water has identified a
number of technical difficulties in attempting to do so but that negotiations are continuing.

Following the presentation and brief discussion, the City Council concurred that this this topic
warrants additional consideration and should be scheduled for discussion at the Policy
Development Session.

ADJOURNED  1

 ADJOURNMENT

meeting scheduled for Tuesday, November 14, 2017 beginning at 7:00 p.m.
